column1: # Game profile of NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition (Switch, base game v0 = 1.0.1; English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Korean, Simplified and
# Traditional Chinese). On the Mac from the boot through the logos, the title, a new game (slot, name, difficulty), the opening text and the prologue's flight-unit section
# (over the sea and in the clouds, shooting, a game over) at 30 fps as on the Switch; not yet run on the iPhone
# PlatinumGames' engine (the Switch port by Virtuos) on NVN, SDK 12.3.9. Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: the logo movies, VP9 in CRI USM through movie::Decoder) + sdk;
# CRIWARE file system, Wwise sound, Havok, Enlighten.
# RomFS: 30 CRI CPK archives (6.2 GB, entries CRILAYLA-compressed) of PlatinumGames DAT archives, loose USM movies (3.5 GB) and Wwise streams. The shaders are 1,371 shader
# files of the engine's older layout (.vso / .pso / .gso / .cso: no magic, a binding table, the code area and the control section), all in five DATs of data000.cpk: shader.dat,
# shader2.dat, shadereff.dat, shadereffcs.dat and autoshadereff.dat (shader_split.py cpk_jobs, pg_shader_old); 1,225 distinct keys, all build but the 4 geometry shaders
# (IndexBuildIndependent_{b,x}{cw,ccw}.gso), which Metal cannot express; two of them are bound in the prologue, with no visible effect so far

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: nninitStartup gives StandardAllocator a 1 MB static block, and the engine
# maps its memory in the alias region itself. Engage's 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region: within seconds of boot the alias region is used up to +4.05 GB with 2.95 GB of
# the 3.21 GB pool mapped, and both stay there through the prologue's flight section (no region request failed, so no node-area cut)
# The title background (ASTC 6x6 sRGB, 1024x1024) sits in a CPU_UNCACHED | GPU_CACHED pool (flags 0x22) and is filled by the CPU after nvnTextureInitialize: no packaged
# layout, no WriteTexels, no flush (an uncached pool needs none). Without both keys it read as all-zero ASTC blocks, the error colour: a magenta title screen
